purpose: PoC PCB and PCBA order profile; supplier quote/assembly review remains part of ordering

board.artwork_policy: Preserve delivered copper widths/gaps and outline; do not substitute a different stackup or resize impedance traces without design review.

assembly.bottom_stencil: none; bottom paste layer is empty

manual.method: separately purchase from LCSC and manually solder; excluded from PCBA BOM and CPL

required_hybrid_assembly: J2: SMT contacts plus all four through-hole shell stakes
J5: all19 SMT signal contacts plus all four through-hole shell tabs
assembly.THT_fallback: If supplier declines J1 or JP1, buy the same selected LCSC part separately and hand solder; update the supplier assembly selection to avoid duplicate procurement.
assembly.U2_PowerPAD: Eight nominal0.3mm thermal holes; preserve supplied solder-mask tenting and the2.6x3.1mm top opening. Do not add bottom paste or open the bottom thermal mask. Review exposed-pad/thermal-via soldering with assembler.

placement.basis: Official LCSC/EasyEDA orientation and rigid frame offsets by numbered pins; preserve manufacturer body centers where library recommended land lengths differ. J1 manufacturer frame(-3,-2.35)mm. Supplied Gerber plot coordinates, +X right/+Y up.
placement.regeneration: The exporter must run finalize_placement.py. Do not replace release CPL with an uncorrected CAD-origin export.
placement.supplier_review: Official library-frame correction is not independent confirmation of tape/reel orientation or final factory placement; review the current order preview against assembly/polarity references.

power_switch: omitted: neither main external-power switch nor old FPGA-only SW3 is fitted

verification.scope: Checks of supplied data and footprint-frame alignment; not factory acceptance or physical validation.
